name: Cueca
label: CUECA
source: Sanchez (UNCuyo) 2004 fig. 3.80.1, cueca cuyana guitar; Duran (U. Playa Ancha) p. 101, Chilean cueca guitar basic pattern (adds treble strokes on 2 and 6); tempo a practice default

sources.title: Octavio Sanchez, La cueca cuyana contemporanea. Identidades sonora y socio-cultural (tesis de maestria, UNCuyo 2004), p. 222 fig. 3.80
sources.shows: Most frequent cueca cuyana rasguidos on a two-line staff (low strings below, treble above, triangle = chasquido). 3.80.1: low quarter on eighth 1, low eighth on 3, chasquido eighth on 4, low quarter on 5. Prose: the low stratum stresses 3/4 on the last two quarter beats, the treble chasquido always on the second dotted quarter (6/8); the last quarter is played slightly accented.

sources.title: Fabian Duran B., Repertorio musical criollo latinoamericano: usos y practicas en Venezuela, Peru, Argentina y Chile (Universidad de Playa Ancha), pp. 99-101
sources.shows: Cueca, 6/8, 'Patron basico para la guitarra': six eighths stroked P M P CH P M (P thumb on the bass strings, M hand, CH chasquido), accents on eighths 2 and 5; text: bass strings (bordones) set apart from trebles, rasgueo plus chasquido.
